RAJYA SABHA 
Wednesday, 21st April, 2010/1st Vaisakha, 1932 (Saka) 
The House met at eleven of the clock, 
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair. 
OBITUARY REFERENCE 
MR. CHAIRMAN : Hon. Members, I refer with pr ofound sorrow to the passing away of Shri 
Krishan Lal Balmiki, a sitting Member, on the 21st of April, 2010, at the age of 67 years. 
Born at Sanganer in Jaipur District of Rajasthan in July, 1942. Shri Balmiki was educated at the 
Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Jaipur. 
Before his entry into politics, Shri Balmiki served in the Indian Airlines. Shri Balmiki was a noted 
social worker and was Chairman of the Safai Karamchari Commission of Rajasthan from January to 
March, 2006. He was also a keen sports lover. 
Shri Krishan Lal Balmiki represented the State of Rajasthan in this House from April, 2006 till his 
sad demise. 
In the passing away of Shri Krishan Lal Balmiki, the country has lost an able Parliamentarian and 
a dedicated social worker. 
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri Krishan Lal Balmiki. 
I request Members to rise in their places and observe silence as a mark of respect to the memory 
of the departed. 
(Hon. Members then stood in silence for one minute) 
MR. CHAIRMAN : Secretary-General will convey to the members of the bereaved family our 
sense of profound sorrow and deep sympathy. 
As a mark of respect to the memory of Shri Krishan Lal Balmiki, a sitting Member, the House 
stands adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Thursday, the 22nd of April, 2010. 
The House then adjourned at three minutes past eleven of the clock, till eleven of the clock on 
Thursday, the 22nd of April, 2010.
